topics.summary: Opener is an open-source reference implementation of the DECT NR+ (formally DECT-2020 NR) protocol stack, targeting massive IoT (mMTC) and low-latency (URLLC) machine-to-machine communication. DECT NR+ is an ETSI-standardized non-cellular 5G technology operating on the 1.9GHz license-free band, supporting mesh topology and gateway-free self-organizing networks with up to millions of nodes and millisecond-level latency. For large-scale smart agriculture sensor deployments, DECT NR+ offers another connectivity route between LoRa/NB-IoT (long-range low-power) and WiFi (high-speed short-range).
